provenance.paper_title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation

representation_paths.memory_component: structured visual experience distilled from best-worst trajectory differences

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Structured visual-experience entries aggregating successful and failed generation patterns. agent consults distilled visual experience to guide subsequent generations.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): Privileged-teacher experience is used for training/post-training improvement; the deployed student does not update memory during inference. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
